versions.changelog:
**Summary:** Adds an explicit scope and trust-warning section; removes obsolete file.

- Added a new section on scope and trusted usage, clarifying how this skill acts and under what conditions it should be run.
- Removed the file `skill-card.md`.
- No changes to command logic or review workflow in core instructions.

- Initial release of the address-review-comments skill.
- Automates addressing the latest PR review comments with a self-audit (consistency, regression, staleness), then commits, pushes, and replies point-by-point.
- Prevents redundant work by detecting when there are no new comments and stops the loop once the reviewer approves.
- Enforces strict review discipline and standing rules to ensure consistent, high-quality PR handling (e.g., one commit per round, never merge, never leak secrets).
- Handles and validates the worktree and full comment history (from all relevant sources) to ensure correct review round processing.
